text:
karen: FYI: rolling out a small billing + rate-policy update next week to improve predictability. Key changes: 1) new "usage tiers" that add a soft throttle step once monthly spend projection exceeds 120% of chosen tier, 2) free credits now show expiry date in billing UI and email reminders at 14/3 days before expiry. Docs: https://redwood.internal/policies/billing-update

mike: Will the soft throttle create 429s or just pace?

karen: It paces. We'll emit header X-Redwood-SoftThrottle: true and a Retry-After-ms value when active. 429s only if requests exceed hard per-second limits.

finance-bot: Billing note: tokens for completed responses are billed as usual. We'll add an invoice tag "Tier-SoftThrottle" when pacing was applied in the billing period. For contested credits expirations, open a billing ticket and we'll review.

support: Adding KB and canned replies now; will include sample curl to show header detection and suggested backoff (exponential with jitter). ETA: EOD today.

ops-bot: Rollout plan: canary Mon 09:00 PT at 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 48h. Abort on p99 latency +6% or error-rate bump. Dashboards: softthrottle_events/min, retry-after-dist, p99_latency.

karen: Comms plan: pre-notify high-usage customers Tue AM, publish blog + docs Wed, in-console banner Wed PM. Any objections, flag before Fri EOD. TL;DR: soft throttle tiering to reduce surprise spend and clearer credit expiry notices; headers + KB for detection.
